Maharashtra CM seeks consensus on curbing loud music during festivals

Maharashtra Chief Minister Eknath Shinde has called for a consensus on regulating loud music, including DJ sets, during festivals. He compared the noise from DJ music to an earthquake, emphasizing the need to preserve traditions. The Chief Minister stated that while festivals are important, the noise levels should be managed. He indicated that discussions would be held to find a balance between celebrations and noise control.
